speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Yeah, of course, I think it's very necessary — especially in China.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: We speak Mandarin here, and in this world, English is the master language.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: There are so many people speaking English, and if you want to communicate with them, you need to speak English too.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Once you learn English well, you broaden your horizon — it's like opening a new gate to the world.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: You gain access to so many things: different people, different scenery, different cultures.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: And learning a new language can also make people smarter — it activates your brain and improves your critical thinking, because you need a lot of input, comprehensive input.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: For example, I learn English from watching TV shows, articles, English novels — and I've gotten to know so many English writers through that.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: This input improved my critical thinking and broadened my horizon.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: So it's a very valuable skill and an impressive experience.
